themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying calls for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to welfare, housing, and employment. This theme has seen strong convergence, particularly in Spain, Italy, Poland, Argentina, and France, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, PiS, and Rassemblement National are either proposing or implementing such measures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands government answers over alleged mass expedited citizenship, calls for national priority in housing and welfare policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports national priority policies in coalition agreements, particularly in housing and employment sectors.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Advocates for national priority in social benefits and criticizes EU migration pacts.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Proposes national priority in local aid and municipal policies, aligning with Vox's rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes national priority in welfare and housing, criticizing immigration policies.
